pages.title: Power Relay Station
pages.text: Xiranite Relay is a variant of repeater in Wuling area, used to transmit power over longer distances. Similar to pylons but with a larger connection range.$(br2)Grid Connection Range: 80m$(br)Supply Range: 10m

pages.title: Use Cases
pages.text: When you need to transport power far from the Protocol Core, place Relay Towers along the path to bridge the distance.$(br2)Relay Towers can chain-connect to each other (within 80m), forming relay chains. Each relay node also supplies power to devices within 10m.
Check the exact recipe in the Crafter. Required materials can be looked up in REI/JEI.
